messages.content: new rust cli for log parsing. clap for args, serde for output
Created src/main.rs, src/parser.rs, Cargo.toml. Decided: clap v4 for argument parsing, serde_json for structured output.
needs to handle 2GB files without loading into memory
Decided: streaming with BufReader instead of read_to_string. Implemented the line iterator in src/parser.rs.
getting a borrow checker error on the iterator
Fixed the borrow checker error — the iterator held a reference across the loop body. Restructured to own the buffer in src/parser.rs.
